title: Principal restrictions inherit the displayed-gap Neumann ceilings (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, bandwidth 2, and `t_i=i`, all 64 principal restrictions of the normalized Schur section on `0,1,2,7,8,9` obey the same Neumann ceilings as the full section: infinity norm at most `27`, 1-norm at most `3938`, and 2-norm strictly below `321`.
- All 192 column deletions stay strictly below the displayed-expression lower bound `L`. In every survivor subset, compressed distance is at most the original survivor distance, and every pair at distance greater than 3 is an exact zero. The lemma therefore still applies at `b=3` and `rho=L`.
- No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. This applies the pinned lemma to one section and its principal restrictions; it does not prove the Neumann series.
